nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventIntro: So, captain… What should we do next?
nodes.eventDescription: At least that explains the time loop. But we need to choose a course of action to break it, preferably with Zephyrus still in one piece.

actions.description: There are other Primordial structures on Keeling. To understand their technology, we must first study it.
actions.resultDescription: We spotted several structures that can be identified as potentially built by the Primordials. They are all in close proximity and potentially reachable by our means of transportation.

actions.description: First, we must find out who destroyed Zephyrus and why.
actions.resultDescription: We have detected several large fragments of Zephyrus nearby. Maybe we could retrieve the Orange box or, at least, examine the debris to learn what type of damage the ship suffered.

actions.description: As we previously found out, the attack could be preceded by sabotage.
actions.resultDescription: We have detected several large fragments of Zephyrus nearby. Maybe we could examine them to learn more about what caused such gruesome damage.

nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: The complex is built on the floating island. We detect an unknown type of EM-field surrounding the structures.

actions.description: Ask for volunteers. Give them the best protection gear we can provide. We have no time to waste.
actions.resultDescription: Scouts managed to stay there only briefly before their protection began to fail.  They managed to escape, taking with them several slabs of an Eldritium, a rare metal. It probably was mined or refined there. Unfortunately, they also carried radiation sickness.

actions.description: This looks dangerous. We should investigate before putting our scouts at risk.
actions.resultDescription: We still don’t exactly understand what this field is or what its purpose is. But now we know the possible hazards and how to avoid them.

actions.description: Using the gathered information, we can providereliable protection for our scouts.
actions.resultDescription: The scouts still have precious little time to explore the complex. Presumably, it was a refinery for Eldritium, with a significant supply of the material still there. Scouts couldn’t take all, but gathered data about the industrial capacities of the Primordials.

nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: This looks more like a spacecraft than a marine building. Or even a space station. Crash-landed in these shallows.

actions.description: Despite the sorry state of the structure, we might recover artifacts
actions.resultDescription: Turns out, this was a space station, orbiting the Keeling some centuries, if not millennia ago. Most of the tech here is beyond our understanding, and the in a sorry state because of its age and conditions, but despite that, the scouts retrieved several artifacts. This may be the first step to a real breakthrough.

actions.description: The structure doesn’t look stable. We’ll be putting our crew at risk, sending them without any prior exploration.
actions.resultDescription: Surprisingly, the structure still holds. Now we can clearly tell it was a large orbital station, which, for some reason, left the orbit and landed in the shallows of this archipelago. There is structural damage here and there, but mostly the station is intact. Whatever caused the station to fall didn’t destroy it. We can proceed with the scouting team.

actions.description: Now, when we are sure the place is safe, we can send our scouts.
actions.resultDescription: This was a space station, orbiting the Keeling some centuries, if not millennia ago. Most of the tech here is beyond our understanding, and the in a sorry state because of its age and conditions, but despite that, the scouts retrieved several artifacts. This may be the first step to a real breakthrough.

nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: The structure is in very bad shape. Once levitating, it is now half-buried in the soil and heavily damaged.

actions.description: Scanners show no life or energy signatures. The place is dead. We can send the team in.
actions.resultDescription: The place was pillaged a long time ago. Everything was either looted, smashed, or turned to rust & dust. All we can extract from here is some basic materials.

actions.description: We need archeologists here, not looters. We must act carefully.
actions.resultDescription:
The place was pillaged a long time ago. However, the scientists manage to gather intel about the pillagers. This was a native Keeling civilization, primitive but resourceful, capable of recycling the tech, not only extracting precious metals and gems from it. It also seems that they didn’t quite finish their business here. There may be something of value still hidden there.
They went on, but to no avail. Yet just as the search began to look futile, archeologists found a hidden chamber with a strange device, possibly still functional.

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: This fragment has traces of an explosion. A careful study can unveil the details of the attack. However, the fragment is small and badly damaged. We aren’t likely to find any surviving data or gear here.

actions.description: Investigation may take precious time, but it’s the only way to find out how the ship was destroyed.
actions.resultDescription: The investigation showed that the explosion was outward, not inward. Which means that something exploded inside the ship. Whether as the result of sabotage or because of some alien technology, causing some internal devices to explode is yet unclear.

actions.description: Time is of the essence. A quick check will do. We know the weapon was of devastating power, so the knowledge won’t save us from it anyhow.
actions.resultDescription: No luck. The fragment is burned out to ash, leaving nothing of value. We managed to retrieve just a small quantity of rare metals.

actions.description: We can base the investigation on the Orange box data to add more pieces to this puzzle.
actions.resultDescription: The investigation showed that the explosion was outward, not inward. Which means that something exploded inside the ship. The Orange box data shows the critical malfunction in the battery block safety systems in this sector of the ship, seconds before the explosion. Further study is required to clarify the connection between these two occurrences.

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventIntro: All the points of interest are checked. We can start the research.
nodes.eventDescription: Gathered artifacts and data can tell us more about the Primordials, their motives, and their current state.

actions.description: We only managed to scratch the surface here. More information will be needed to obtain a deeper understanding of the Primordials, but it’s a start.
actions.resultDescription: Despite the first meeting with the Prims, all the structures we’ve found were deserted many centuries ago. What was the creature the Captain spoke to? A ghost? Or maybe they moved on – deeper into the sea perhaps? However, we didn’t find anything that could help us with the riddle of the Prism. We must continue our search.

actions.description: We’ve gathered a lot of data. The Primordials are an advanced and mysterious species, but this research may become a first step in understanding their motives.
actions.resultDescription: We had a first contact, but what was the creature that contacted us? All the structures we explored, even those that were still functioning, were deserted ages ago! Yet, the artifacts we’ve found and the processed data show the possibility of the multidimensional technology being used by the Primordals. However, such tech might require huge amounts of energy. How the Prism is functioning without the potent energy source, and whether there is a limit to its uses, remains unknown.

actions.description: We managed to gather a massive amount of data to research. The main problem now is how to process it.
actions.resultDescription: The data shows that the first contact we had wasn’t a direct contact. At least not as direct as we thought it was. The Primodial wasn’t there in full, and we aren’t even sure that he could be present in a full material form. The one Voss talked to could be either an AI avatar, a transdimensional projection, or even an interactive semi-intelligent recording of the person long gone. The artifacts collected are mostly functional and can be studied to gain a better understanding of the prims’ technology, especially the Prism. What we know now is that the Prism is autonomous and powered by the source beyond our 4 dimensions. All attempts to mess with it will lead to the safety reboot, as well as any serious damage to the ship and crew. We can’t help but wonder: could Zephyrus survive the attack if the Prism were still aboard it?

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: This fragment is badly damaged, but the damage itself is a bit strange. A closer look shows that the wreck was looted by someone.

actions.description: Have to be quicker next time. Let's retrieve what we can and move on.
actions.resultDescription: The looters were there, and now they are gone. They took almost everything of value. At least all that survived the crash.  All that is left for us is just the basic materials like metal and plastic.

actions.description: Secure the wreck in case the looters are still around and then extract the valuables.
actions.resultDescription:
Whoever did this has some industrial equipment. Not that advanced, but effective. We found some remnants of it: broken parts, exhausted batterys etc. The looters took all they could, even the metal plates that they managed to tear off. They had to have a large vessel to carry all that of the island. Also they picked up all the surviving electronics for some reason.
Were they just occasional marauders or intently covered the tracks of the attack?
One of them lost some kind of decoration, abadge or something. Maybe it will guide us to the marauders in the future.

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventDescription: This fragment had sunken by the time we arrived, but scanners detected a strange signal nearby.

actions.description: The waters are shallow here. Maybe we can use divers to reach the Fragment?
actions.resultDescription: No use. Our divers reached the fragment but barely had time to explore it. The local fauna is very aggressive there, so they had to withdraw soon. Still, they managed to recover a data cluster.

actions.description: It might be just our luck, but we should definitely check it.
actions.resultDescription: We found an alien device, damaged by the impact of the fragment’s fall. The device is not functioning, but the examination proves it was a powerful jamming device, perhaps one of those that interfered with the signal from Zephyrus. Hard to tell who built it: the tech is clearly alien and relatively complex.

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.eventIntro: The R&D formed a task force to study the Explosion
nodes.eventDescription: The data gathered from the damaged Zephyrus fragment could shed some light on the circumstances of the Zephyrus destruction

actions.description: Engineers can research on the Zephyrus design to explain what exactly happened
actions.resultDescription: The report shows that the source of the explosion was the large battery block that feeds the entire Zephyrus section. It is highly unlikely that it exploded due to a critical malfunction. It could be either a concentrated, highly penetrative radiation beam, used as a weapon. Or, it was a planned diversion. Someone either infiltrated the ship or was already aboard to prepare and execute it.

actions.description: Abbadie suggest deeper research of the Orange Box data to match the gathered data on the explosion
actions.resultDescription:
The results show that the malfunction of the battery block, leading to the explosion, started 78 seconds before the explosion. This makes the sabotage theory highly improbable, for in such a short time, the saboteur couldn’t possibly escape the explosion, not to say reach the escape pods. It could have been the result of the outer action, most likely the penetrative radiation, strong enough to break through the Zephyrus’s shields.
Yet one group of researchers states that the earlier records contain data on the safety system breach in this sector, which suggests the sabotage was a planned-ahead action.
This could mean that the saboteur left Zephyrus. Perhaps even as a part of the Behemoth crew.

nodes.name: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.title: Once More Into The Frey
nodes.location: Both T1-V2-K2E and T1-V2-K2F are resolved
nodes.spawnConditions: Both T1-V2-K2E and T1-V2-K2F are resolved
nodes.eventIntro: All the fragments in the vicinity are investigated. We can go on with the conclusion
nodes.eventDescription: We gathered enough cues to figure at least some part of the tragedy.

actions.description: We can analyze the retrieved data from Zephyrus
actions.resultDescription: Gathered data showed the massive cyber attack on the ship's internal network several minutes before the attack. This proves the attack was planned and orchestrated with frightening accuracy. We are facing a fearsome and cunning foe, and must be prepared that they may strike again at any time.

actions.description: We have to learn more about the looters
actions.resultDescription: The overall analysis shows that the looters present the civilization in its industrial age. They use heat and electricity, but not nuclear power. They have heavy machinery developed sea fleet, and a complex social structure. Yet it seems unlikely that they are capable of shooting down Zephyrus size ship from orbit. Why the uninstalled electronic equipment remains unclear. Perhaps, relics provided us with a limited perspective of these species. We have to find and contact them to learn more.

actions.description: We can study the retrieved fragments of the jammer in the lab
actions.resultDescription: The Jammer is a sample of a highly advanced space tech. Whether the ones who made it are locals or aliens to this planet, they are on the same or even higher level than us. We have (at least for now) no effective means to counter such a jammer.

lines.text: Immediately after the drop, the cutscene with the destruction of Zepyrus triggers. The following dialogue describes the shock the team fell into, completely dazed by their sudden time loop. It takes effort to overcome the shock and start doing something.  As this was the first return, the dialogues must demonstrate the confusion and surprise
Key Event marker spawns on the island with the Primordial structure. Scouting the event triggers the cutscene in which Voss meets the Primordials. After the cutscene ends, the 0A Event triggers.
